correctness.rationale: In the fixed-angle measurable paired-arc profile family, the Green-theorem area quadratic form is nonpositive on the two-moment constraint space: write p''+p=f, endpoints p=p'=0, so Q(f)=∫(p²-p'²)≤0 for 2m<π. The known dual potential is exactly D(x)=0 centrally and 1−cos(|x|−a) on exterior arcs. If 0≤r≤1/2, zero cosine moment gives inner gain I≤outer loss O, so N=I+O≤2O. Bathtub ordering with outer loss density bounded by 1 and 1−cos y≥2y²/π² gives deficit≥N³/(12π²). Exact symmetric bands meeting both moments have deficit=δ³/2+O(δ⁴), N=2δ+O(δ²), so ratio→1/16. Smooth high-frequency even signed zero-moment perturbations have fixed positive L¹ mass and compact-kernel deficit→0. Independently computed band identity and asymptotic ratios for several δ at m=1.
